# Loupe Jewels

> Loupe Jewels (Loupe Jewellery LLP) is an Indian luxury fine jewellery house based in Surat, Gujarat. We handcraft ethical, certified lab-grown diamond and BIS hallmarked gold jewellery, featuring engagement rings, solitaire necklaces, tennis bracelets, earrings, and bespoke custom commissions.

Loupe Jewels blends centuries-old Gujarati goldsmithing artistry with state-of-the-art diamond science. Every diamond is certified to rigorous IGI/GIA standards for cut, color, clarity, and carat weight, set in solid 14K or 18K yellow gold, rose gold, white gold, and platinum.

## Collections
- [All Jewellery](https://loupejewels.com/all-jewellery): Full boutique catalog of certified diamond and gold jewellery.
- [Rings](https://loupejewels.com/all-jewellery/category/rings): Solitaire engagement rings, eternity bands, halo rings, and everyday sparkle.
- [Earrings](https://loupejewels.com/all-jewellery/category/earrings): Diamond studs, drop earrings, huggies, and festive chandbalis.
- [Necklaces](https://loupejewels.com/all-jewellery/category/necklace): Solitaire pendants, tennis chokers, and bridal necklaces.
- [Bracelets](https://loupejewels.com/all-jewellery/category/bracelets): Tennis bracelets, cuffs, and delicate daily-wear chains.
- [Product Catalogue](https://loupejewels.com/product-catalogue): Filterable complete gallery of all in-stock and made-to-order pieces.
- [Bespoke Custom Jewellery](https://loupejewels.com/customize): 1-on-1 custom jewellery consultations with 3D CAD design.
